title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-20
lineage: MAC (Taped by Cary Wolfson, Sony 1-point stereo mic > Sony TC-124) > Nak Dragon playback > ART DI/O > HD > Cool Edit 2000 > master CD > EAC>  SHN

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality audience recording of the historic 11/20/73 Boulder show captures a soaring set with Jerry’s peak guitar work and a sublime China Cat Sunflower→New Rider transition.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised – Bob Weir shines, Jerry Garcia delivers one of his best tones, and the second‑set flow (notably China Cat Sunflower into New Rider) is described as sublime.  The tape is an audience (AUD) source that many call “cloudy” or “muddy,” though a few listeners say it almost sounds like a soundboard.  Overall the musical highs outweigh the lo‑fi audio, making it a must‑listen for fans of this era.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show quality (high energy, standout performances) weighted at 70% and fair but acceptable audience recording quality weighted at 30% yields an overall rating around 4/5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is described as muddy, cloudy and not a great AUD; some listeners note occasional lack of clarity, though a few say it approaches soundboard quality.

standout_songs: Various Weir‑centric numbers (noted by fans as favorites)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set strong and cohesive; second set considered killer with freer, inspired playing that showcases the band’s peak in the fall tour.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise his guitar tone as perfect and note he was 'peaking' on this night.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted as a Weir‑fan favorite; several comments say Bob Weir is ‘on’ and the show is great for his fans.
